# AIOS Executive Briefing Principle

An Executive Briefing should replace hours of manual reporting.

The executive should finish reading it and immediately know:

What happened.

Why it happened.

Why it matters.

What will happen next.

What requires attention today.

What AI recommends.

Every briefing should feel like it was prepared overnight by an experienced executive leadership team that analyzed every part of the business and distilled it into the information that truly matters.
